meta.description: MixPad S Flagship smart panel: award-winning design with new light gold and titanium white finishes, a 3W stereo speaker, a classic Swiss-style clock face, voice and touch control for the whole home, and lifetime OTA updates.
banner.award1:
Pioneer of the super
smart switch category
banner.award2:
The industry's most awarded
wall interaction product
sec3.quote:
“Contemporary technology housed in a case with a refined
outward appearance characterises the MixPad S smart
control panel.”
sec4.title: More striking
sec4.desc: MixPad S Flagship adds new light gold and titanium white finishes. With several colors to choose from, you can make it your own.
sec5.title: Richer sound
sec5.desc:
A built-in 3W stereo digital box speaker.
A quality acoustic system sounds professional, with a vast licensed music library to enjoy without limits.
sec6.title: More distinctive
sec6.desc:
MixPad S Flagship has its own classic
Swiss-style clock face, for those who
value old-world craftsmanship.
sec7.title: Smarter
sec7.desc: Voice control, touch control and environment sensing make your lighting, AC, floor heating, fresh air, curtains, security, background music and more smart and automatic, for a whole new way of living at home.
sec8.title:
Innovative
interaction
sec8.desc: A reinvented home interaction experience that rewrites the rules of AI voice control: no wake word, and commands run instantly. You and technology have never been so in sync.
sec8.caption: The industry's first wall interaction device to win a Red Dot interaction design award
sec9.title: The more you use it, the “newer” it gets
sec9.desc:
MixPad S Flagship runs HOME AI, its own smart home operating system,
with lifetime OTA updates, so software keeps delivering a better smart experience.
sec10.title: Stunning looks: a work of art for your wall
sec10.desc:
Created by an iF Gold Award-winning design team, MixPad S has won 5 major international design awards.
Its strong, clean lines bring a minimalist new look to home technology, made for refined taste, in several colors.
meta.spec.description: MixPad S Flagship smart panel specifications: 4-inch 480 × 480 screen, quad-core CPU, Zigbee, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, two lighting circuits.
spec.color: Colors: elegant gray, titanium white, light gold, luxe gray
spec.protocols: Protocols: Zigbee, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, expandable to Ethernet
spec.backBox: Back box: standard single 86 mm box
